The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Bugs fixed in `rtl/debouncer.v`:
1. The counter was never cleared when `din == dout`, so stale counts from prior disagreements could persist.
2. Off-by-one: the toggle condition compared `cnt == N`, which required N+1 edges; changed to `cnt == N - 1` so `dout` toggles exactly on the N-th consecutive differing edge.
